policy.claim_scope_rule: Synthetic fixtures and mocks may regression-test an already admitted adapter but cannot admit one.
policy.persiangravity_note: No first-party documentation host is admitted by this WU. PersianGravity adapter admission therefore remains fail-closed to AUTHENTIC_RUNTIME evidence until an owner-approved first-party source is recorded.
policy.evidence_artifact_requirement: Every admitted adapter evidence record must bind to a repository-controlled sanitized evidence artifact by exact SHA-256. Metadata-only or URL-only admission is rejected.
